place.name: Island of Palmas Case
place.description: The Island of Palmas Case was a territorial dispute over the Island of Palmas (or Miangas) between the Netherlands and the United States which was heard at the Permanent Court of Arbitration by arbitrator Max Huber. Palmas (Indonesian: Pulau Miangas) was declared to be a part of the Netherlands East Indies and is now part of Indonesia.
